verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is an interactive iOS/iPadOS terminal client. Headless or scripted automation is a fair question for a terminal product, but the evidence only shows interactive, touch-driven use. The only nearby material is in-app scripting with Python or Lua, which is an adjacent feature, not a headless or CI execution mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
